summary: Counts scene/season path entries on the active entity list. Builds a visited-flag array over the first ActiveEntityCounter(this)+1 entity indices, resolves each index to a scene path pointer (FixedOffsetReturn for index 0, ShortComputation_13a0 for later indices), and reads its 32-byte season name via SceneNameLookupBySeason. For each entry whose name equals the target a2, it scans the following entries, flags every one whose name does NOT equal the matched name (skipping them), and increments a counter when the per-entry computed value from sub_4C13C0 exceeds the reference value computed for a2. Returns -1 for a null target and 1 for an empty list.

local_names.this: object carrying the active entity / scene path list
local_names.a2: target name compared against scene season names; null aborts with -1
local_names.v4: outer scan index over scene path entries
local_names.v5: scene path pointer for the outer entry
local_names.v6: inner scan index starting after v4
local_names.v7: scene path pointer for the inner entry
local_names.v10: reference value from sub_4C13C0 for the target a2
local_names.i: computed value from sub_4C13C0 for the matched season name
local_names.v12: 32-byte season-name buffer for the matched entry
local_names.v13: 32-byte season-name buffer for the inner entry
local_names.v14: 104-byte visited/flag array over the scan range
